Class Board

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.gameModel.board.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
IF_GameModel
public class Board extends Object implements IF_GameModel
Representation of the Game Board.
This Class works as the representation of the Game Board, which defines the Model in the ModelViewController Pattern.

      Description copied from interface: IF_GameModel
      Load the Game.

    • pickCard

      public boolean pickCard(Player player, CharacterCard card) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: IF_GameModel
      Move - Pick Card (Character Card).
      This method updates the Model due to the move "Pick Card" done from a Player, in particular this method works with Character Cards.
      If the Card is not displayed on the Board, nothing happens.
      Pre: player != null && card != null
      Specified by:
      pickCard in interface IF_GameModel
      Parameters:
      player - Player who has made the move.
      card - Card picked by the Player.
      Returns:
      True if the Move ended successfully, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.
      See Also:
      • Board implementation of the pickCard method (Character Card).
